info.title: Elys API
info.description: Elys OFM Management API - AI-powered content creator management platform

cookieAuth.name: better-auth.session_token
cookieAuth.description: Session cookie set by BetterAuth after login

get.description: Get a paginated list of all users. Only accessible by managers.

post.description: Create a new user account. Only managers can create users.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile information
Get detailed information about a specific user

patch.description: Update an existing user's profile or role

get.description: Get a paginated list of models the current user has access to. MANAGER users see models they manage, MODEL users see only their own model.

post.description: Create a new model profile. Only MANAGER users can create models. The creating manager becomes the model's manager.

get.description: Get detailed information about a specific model including persona settings

patch.description: Update an existing model's profile, persona, or settings. Only MANAGER users can update models.

delete.description: Permanently delete a model and all associated data. This action cannot be undone.

post.description: Configure a model's AI personality using preset options. This provides a guided way to set up the persona without configuring each field individually.

get.description: Get all available preset options for quick personality setup. Use these values with the quick-setup endpoint.
Get a paginated list of fans for the current model. Supports filtering by platform, subscription status, and AI score.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by username or display name

post.description: Create a new fan record (typically synced from external platform)

get.description: Get detailed information about a specific fan including spending history and engagement data

patch.description: Update fan information or AI score

delete.description: Permanently delete a fan record and all associated data

post.description: Associate a tag with a fan for categorization

delete.description: Remove a tag association from a fan

get.description: Get a paginated list of conversations for the model. Supports filtering by platform, archive status, and unread messages.
Get detailed information about a conversation including recent messages preview

patch.description: Update conversation status (archive, mark as read)

post.description: Generate a single AI-powered response that matches the model's persona. The AI uses conversation history and fan context for personalization.

fanMessage.description: The fan's message to respond to

post.description: Generate 3 different response variations with varying tones for the user to choose from

fanMessage.description: The fan's message to respond to

post.description: Analyze if a response text matches the model's configured persona style. Returns a match score and suggestions.

post.description: Generate multiple AI-powered chat response variations

get.description: Get AI conversation memory (long-term and short-term)

Record an emotional event for memory tracking

get.description: Get AI service status and configuration

post.description: Invalidate model profile cache (call after updating model profile)
